criteria.description: Terminology: five accurate definitions/analogies worth 2 each (1 meaning, 1 analogy with mapping).

criteria.feedback: Missing or incorrect prediction. Trace the example and check JSON types, then retry.

criteria.description: Write a Dockerfile based on the example for your Django project. Include explicit dependency versions and describe every instruction. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Write .dockerignore excluding .git, .venv, node_modules, .env and private local database files. Inspect build context contents for accidental data inclusion. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Build an emio24-dev image and record its image ID plus build output. If offline artifacts are missing, record the missing prerequisite rather than a fabricated build. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Run a disposable container mapping host 8080 to 8000. Request the health endpoint, record 200, then stop the container. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Provide a dummy environment variable at runtime and read it through settings. Show it is not baked into the Dockerfile or image source. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Mount a dedicated practice volume for database/data storage. Create a product, replace the container using the same volume, and show the product persists. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

List required Docker engine, base image and dependency artifacts. Write reproducible build/run/stop instructions and explain the production changes still needed before deployment. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
